title: Milo Mole and the Midnight Moon
description: A little mole who is afraid of the dark learns to appreciate the beauty of night time.
character_reference: a small dusty-brown mole with oversized round spectacles and a bright yellow striped vest

scenes.narration: Milo Mole loved his cozy underground bedroom, but when the sun went down, he pulled his fuzzy blanket right over his nose.
scenes.visual: close-up portrait in a cozy earthen burrow, pulling a thick woven blanket tightly up around chin, wide worried eyes peering over the edge, soft amber lantern glow

scenes.narration: His mother gently nudged him toward the surface. She whispered that the night world was full of wonders, not worries.
scenes.visual: gentle interior tunnel scene, adult mole paw resting softly on small shoulder, encouraging expression, warm earthy tones, dim background corridor

scenes.narration: Stepping out of the dark tunnel, Milo squeezed his eyes shut. The cool night air felt very different from his warm home.
scenes.visual: low angle shot emerging from round hole in grass, shivering slightly, eyes squeezed tight in hesitation, cool blue night atmosphere, dewy blades of grass

scenes.narration: Then, a tiny flicker of light danced past his nose. It was a friendly firefly, glowing like a floating star.
scenes.visual: macro view looking up in wonder, glowing yellow insect hovering near whiskered snout, wide astonished eyes, dark blurry meadow background

scenes.narration: Milo opened his eyes a little wider. Above him, a million tiny stars twinkled softly in the velvet sky.
scenes.visual: sitting on a smooth mound of dirt, gazing straight up with mouth slightly open in awe, vast starry night sky reflected in large round spectacles

scenes.narration: He realized the dark wasn't empty or scary at all. It was just a quiet blanket for the sleeping world.
scenes.visual: peaceful profile shot smiling gently, relaxing posture, soft silver moonlight casting delicate shadows on green hill, calm night breeze

scenes.narration: Milo smiled and looked forward to every peaceful night under the glowing stars.
scenes.visual: happy sleepy expression, laying down comfortably on mossy pillow outdoors, contented smile, gentle glowing fireflies drifting nearby

scenes.narration: Every night holds a special magic if we take time to look. Follow along for more bedtime stories.
scenes.visual: waving goodbye cheerfully with one paw, tilted head, twinkling star overhead, soft magical glow, cozy bedtime mood
